authorization.source: explicit human instruction in the active pi session
authorization.scope: follow-on post-hoc single-witness study with refittable native Wigner-Seitz shell scales; no Slater-Koster model

model_family.supports: H-shell-00 through H-shell-16 as proper reduced native complete Wigner-Seitz supports
model_family.full_support_control: H-shell-17 retained only as the excluded exact-source control
model_family.parameterization: one real scale alpha_s shared by every effective Hamiltonian block in complete shell s
model_family.formula: H_alpha(R)=alpha_s H_W(R) for R in retained shell s and zero outside the support

bounds.interpretation: post-hoc nonnegative shell-strength exploration; sign reversal and more-than-doubling are excluded

constraints: same alpha_s for all representatives in one complete physical-radius shell
no matrix-entry, orbital-semantic, or Slater-Koster refit

losses.tau_1: uniform-408-point RMS ordered-spectrum error divided by 1 eV
losses.tau_2: uniform-408-point RMS Hamiltonian Frobenius error per retained state divided by 1 eV

optimization.method: bounded L-BFGS-B with analytic binary64 gradients
starts: continuation from the preceding scalarization optimum
optimization.disposition: constructive witness search only; failure to find a witness is not a global infeasibility certificate
